title: Blind check set for the placement of the plan S01 on today's ground (Round 8)
rule: Picked before any fit of Round 8, by five readers who never saw a transform's prediction or an error: each feature found by its form on a crop of today's imagery and a crop of the plan whose centre was shifted at random by up to 35 m, read on zoomed crops with labelled grids. Only features unchanged since 1860 (lake and island shores that keep their old form, ruin foundations in place, gates rebuilt on their base, the garden wall rebuilt on the old line); each at least 30 m from any Round 1 fit point (60 m in the first wave; changed before any error was computed, because the Round 1 fit already holds most sharp surviving features) and 60 m from every other check point. Frozen by a SHA-256 of the points; never edited after: a doubt goes in `annotations`. No Round 8 control point within 60 m of a check point enters a fit (georef.py).
datum: lon, lat WGS84 (EPSG:4326), read on Esri World Imagery (S160, Web Mercator on WGS84, checked against OSM to about 3 m); plan_x, plan_y pixels on research/raw/plans/princeton_mosaic.jpg

points.feature: bridge over the mouth of the channel leaving the SW corner of the 海岳开襟 lake southwards (between the west strip and the 思永斋 island), bridge centre
points.unchanged_because: the lake corner and the channel south of it keep their old form; today's footbridge spans the same channel mouth as the bridge drawn on the plan (abutments not verified)
points.note: today's bridge is modern-looking; same place by the channel form, but its exact line may differ by a few metres

points.feature: north lake below 泽兰堂/宝相寺: its NW corner, apex where the north shore turns south along the root of the long strip from 海岳开襟
points.unchanged_because: Changchun lake shore re-dug on the old outline; the corner keeps its form
points.note: plan corner is rounded (r about 6 m), read at its apex; the plan has a zigzag bridge running SW from just south of the corner, not visible today, so the ground west of the corner may have changed

points.feature: 海岳开襟 lake, NW corner: SW tip of the peninsula between the lake and the channel running north towards the Xiyang Lou strip (west of 法慧寺)
points.unchanged_because: Changchun lake shore and the channel north of it kept in form (re-dug on the old outline)
points.note: the plan tip is sharp, where a zigzag bridge leaves it SW (no bridge today); today's tip is a broad rounded beach about 15 m wide, read at its SW-most point

points.feature: south mouth of the narrow channel east of the 思永斋 island, where it opens into the south lake; centre of the mouth (on the plan the centre of the bridge across it)
points.unchanged_because: the channel and the lake shore keep their old form (re-dug on the old outline); channel width matches the plan (about 15 m)
points.note: no bridge today across the mouth; today's banks flare at the mouth, centre read between the ends of the straight banks

points.feature: SE corner of the north lake (NE of 含经堂): south end of the narrow N-S channel (about 4-5 m wide) that ends just north of a small pavilion
points.unchanged_because: narrow channel kept in its old line (same width, same pavilion site south of its end)
points.note: identified by the channel plus pavilion pair; the pavilion today is a larger modern one; the plan's inlet with gourd islets north of the channel is land today, so some doubt on the ground around it

points.feature: south end of the channel west of the 思永斋 island (north of 茜园): SW end of the diagonal causeway that crosses the water SW-NE, where it leaves the west bank
points.unchanged_because: the channel's west bank keeps its form and today's causeway leaves it at the same bend and in the same direction (about 20 deg N of E) as on the plan
points.note: today's causeway is about half as long as the plan's (24 m against about 50 m) because a peninsula now reaches out from the NE; only the SW end is read

points.feature: 含经堂 compound: centre of the 淳化轩 Chunhua Xuan hall platform (the long hall between the rockery court and the 含经堂 court, on the axis)
points.unchanged_because: excavated and displayed foundation in place; the rockery remains just north of it and the platform size (about 35 x 12.6 m) match the plan
points.note: Wave 2 (30 m rule); today's south edge of the platform is less sharp than the north edge, centre read between them on the axis given by the gap in the rockery

points.feature: 澹怀堂 Danhuai Tang, the front hall of Changchun Yuan on the axis of 长春园宫门: centre of the main hall platform (without the moon terrace in front)
points.unchanged_because: excavated and displayed hall platform in place, with its moon terrace on the south side, as drawn
points.note: Wave 2 (30 m rule). Depth matches (about 20 m on both) but today's platform is about 32 m wide against about 27 m on the plan, and today's terrace is larger and sits a little east of the axis; centre read on the platform's own outline on both

points.feature: 玉玲珑馆 Yulinglong Guan island: NW corner, where its west shore along the channel from 含经堂 meets its north shore on the north lake
points.unchanged_because: island shore kept in its old form (re-dug on the old outline); channel width west of it (about 35 m) matches the plan
points.note: Wave 2 (30 m rule). Rounded corner (radius about 5 m) read at its apex; today a curved line (dam or shallow edge) closes the dark channel water from the lake just west of the corner, not on the plan

points.feature: island north of the canal from 福海's NE bay to 五孔闸 (south of 方壶胜境), west tip of its rounded west lobe
points.unchanged_because: lake island shore between Fuhai's NE bay and the east canal, kept in form (rounded lobe and canal to its south on both)
points.note: plan draws the lobe with a thin outer line and a thick inner line; the outer (water) line read. Today's tip is a bare earth bank; a few metres of bank wear possible

points.feature: 蓬岛瑶台 east islet (瀛海仙山, round rockwork islet), centre of its outline
points.unchanged_because: small island in Fuhai kept in form, rockwork rim and the bridge to the main island at its south-west on both
points.note: centre taken as the middle of the outer rim (left/right/top/bottom extremes) on both; 30.3 m from F03, just over the Wave 2 limit

points.feature: lens-shaped island with a hall, in the lake WNW of 正觉寺: centre of the island (mid of its long and short extents)
points.unchanged_because: island kept in its lake with the same lens form, long axis WSW-ENE, tapering west tip; lake re-dug on the old outline (north shore runs NE on both, 正觉寺 to its ESE on both)
points.note: today the island is about 103 x 70 m, on the plan about 70 x 38 m: shores enlarged or the plan drawn small; centre read the same way on both (bounding extents), so +-8 m doubt

points.feature: oval island north of 涵秋馆, west side of the 凤麟洲 lake: south tip (southernmost point of its rounded south end)
points.unchanged_because: east shore and rounded south end of the old N-S oval island survive as the lake shore (straight N-S east shore, rounded south end, 凤麟洲 to its SE and the 涵秋馆 ground to its south on both)
points.note: today a promontory: the water west of the island is filled, so only the east shore and the south end are compared; rounded tip +-4 m

points.feature: west Qichun: NW inner corner of the large walled enclosure south of the boundary canal (road outside its west and north sides), today the NW corner of the fenced site west of 101 中学
points.unchanged_because: the site boundary keeps the enclosure's right-angle corner with a N-S road outside its west side and the canal line (tree belt) to the north, as on the plan; a later boundary on the old line, not a surviving wall
points.note: today a construction site under green netting; its edge is modern and only assumed to follow the old wall; the fenced site is about 170 m wide, the plan enclosure wider (over 230 m), so only the corner is compared

points.feature: 正觉寺 Zhengjue Si, main hall south of the octagonal 文殊亭: centre of the hall
points.unchanged_because: 正觉寺 survived 1860; its halls stand (restored) on their own bases, octagon north of the main hall on both
points.note: read on the roof, which leans in the off-nadir image (2-4 m) and includes the front porch; plan centre of the hall body without porch

points.feature: 绮春园宫门 Qichun Yuan palace gate (大宫门): centre of the gate hall
points.unchanged_because: gate rebuilt 1988 on its old site (a later source); width 22 m today against 20 m on the plan, forecourt to its south, second gate about 35 m north on both
points.note: image: centre of the white roof (lean of a few m possible); plan: centre of the 5-bay hall, not of the terrace drawn south of it

points.feature: 方河 Fang He, the rectangular pool east of 线法山: centre (mid of its four sides)
points.unchanged_because: the rectangular pool is kept (re-dug) in its old form and orientation; rounded ends and long sides match the plan
points.note: centre from the four sides; the south side on the imagery is half in tree shadow (+-4 m in y); the pool is about 143 x 45-54 m

points.feature: 同乐园 south canal: west end of the canal segment east of the causeway on the south axis of 同乐园 (centre of the end)
points.unchanged_because: straight E-W canal south of 同乐园 kept in its old line (re-dug, lined); its west end stops at the old causeway on the 同乐园 axis, drawn on the plan as the gap between two canal rectangles
points.note: today a small bridge/steps stand at the end; west of it today's water turns south as a pond, unlike the plan's straight segment, so only the east segment's end is read

points.feature: 舍卫城 Shewei Cheng, south-west corner of the town wall (south end of the surviving west wall)
points.unchanged_because: the ruined town wall of 舍卫城 survives as an earth/brick bank in place on the west, north and east sides; the rectangle measures about 84 x 111 m today against about 81 x 108 m on the plan
points.note: the south wall is not visible today, so the corner is read as the south end of the west wall bank (its centre line); the bank is about 8 m wide, the plan draws the wall as a thin double line

points.feature: 碧桐书院 Bitong Shuyuan island, north tip of the small round promontory on its north shore (into the moat channel)
points.unchanged_because: the island's north shore keeps its old line along the moat channel; the round promontory (about 13 m across on both) is today edged with a white stone revetment in the same form
points.note: the revetment is modern work; the form and size match the plan's knob (with a small circle inside on the plan), but a re-dug shore may have shifted a few metres

points.feature: 坦坦荡荡 Tantan Dangdang fish pool (金鱼池), NW corner of the north-west quarter basin
points.unchanged_because: excavated and displayed pool foundation in place; the four-basin plan with the causeway and the small structure in the NW basin matches the plan
points.note: corner of the stone rim on imagery, inner line of the basin on the plan

points.feature: Yuanming Yuan garden wall, NW corner, inner corner of the wall
points.unchanged_because: the park's NW corner wall, rebuilt 1984-2006 on the old line (a later source); the plan draws the wall as a double line with a rounded outer corner, read at the inner corner
points.note: today the corner is boxed by a highway (W) and a road and railway (N); imagery read at the inner corner where the park ground begins, under the wall's shadow; whether the modern wall is exactly on the old line here is not proven

not_admitted.feature: 鉴碧亭 lake, north shore: bridge across the mouth of the narrow N-S channel entering the lake from the north (between two islets, west of the 敷春堂 group): centre of the bridge
not_admitted.unchanged_because: the channel (about 11-12 m wide on both) and the bridge at its lake mouth keep their place on the re-dug lake's north shore; same form on both: straight N-S channel, bridge spanning it just above the open lake
not_admitted.note: image: a light bridge deck spanning the channel at its south end, channel edges visible for about 27 m under trees (41 m on the plan); bridge may be rebuilt; +-4 m
not_admitted.reason: withdrawn by its reader as a probable misidentification (the bridge stands 30 m west and 85 m north of 鉴碧亭's island; the plan's 20 m east and 110 m north)
